items.claim: copyWith accepts a nickname parameter and ignores it: line 23 always passes this.nickname, so copyWith(nickname: x) silently keeps the old value.
reload() returns early once a profile is cached, so it never reloads after the first call; the name promises a refresh while the body is a load-once guard.
The loaded profile goes into a private field with no getter, stream or notifier, so nothing outside the controller can read what reload() loaded.
_fetch performs no I/O: it is an async stub returning a hard-coded placeholder customer built from unexplained literals, under a name that implies a real load.
The cache check runs before the await, so overlapping reload() calls both fetch; a failed fetch has no handling and leaves no error state.
CustomerProfile is an immutable value type with copyWith but no == or hashCode, so equal copies compare unequal.
